author: Jason Stys
summary: Deduplicate private corpus inputs and reduce twice-confirmed owned-parser disagreements under shared time/attempt budgets.
rationale: Produces reproducible smaller debugging cases while preserving unstable and inconclusive outcomes.
limitations: Reduction preserves a twice-confirmed agreement/disagreement partition, not necessarily the same root cause or a globally minimal input.
Unstable and inconclusive executions remain distinct from reproducible findings under shared attempt/time budgets.
Exported reduction reports contain hashes and lengths rather than source paths or payload bytes; the library can return bytes to its caller.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
